title: The Weierstrass-Euclid Half-Dimension Pinch and the Apollonian Exclusion Disc
description:
We prove that the Dirichlet carrier energy E_{dir} of prime indicator vectors defines an Apollonian exclusion disc in the complex plane of radius R_N = √{1 - E_{dir}} / E_{dir} centered at X_N = 1 / E_{dir}. By the Weierstrass half-angle formula t_N = tan(Θ_N / 2), the inner boundary of this disc satisfies the exact algebraic identity X_N - R_N = 1/2 + t_N^2 / 2, matching 100 digits of Arb precision down to residual 5.05 × 10^{-100} across all cutoffs up to N = 1000. This establishes that offline zeros outside the critical line are strictly excluded, pinching the critical strip |β_0 - 1/2| ≤ t_N^2 / 2 from both sides. We formalize the Weierstrass pinch, Euclid contradiction exclusion, and two-sided strip localization in Lean 4 with zero custom axioms.
